proof_body:
by
  intro κ _ C
  let cover : Set (Set ℕ+) := Set.range (fun k : κ => {n : ℕ+ | C n = k})
  have hfin : cover.Finite := Set.finite_range _
  have hcov : (⊤ : Set ℕ+) ⊆ ⋃₀ cover := by
    intro n _
    exact ⟨{m : ℕ+ | C m = C n}, ⟨C n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨k, rfl⟩, a, ha⟩ := Hindman.exists_FS_of_finite_cover cover hfin hcov
  have key : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty), ∃ x ∈ Hindman.FS (a.drop (s.min' hs)), (x : ℕ) = ∑ i ∈ s, (a.get i : ℕ) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.eraseInduction with
    | H s ih =>
      intro hs
      rcases (s.erase (s.min' hs)).eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
      · refine ⟨(a.drop (s.min' hs)).head, Hindman.FS.head _, ?_⟩
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (s.min'_mem hs), h, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero, Stream'.head_drop]
      · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := ih _ (s.min'_mem hs) h
        refine ⟨(a.drop (s.min' hs)).head + x, Hindman.FS.cons _ _ ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Stream'.tail_eq_drop, Stream'.drop_drop, add_comm]
          have hlt : s.min' hs + 1 ≤ (s.erase (s.min' hs)).min' h := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.min'_lt_of_mem_erase_min' _ _ <| Finset.min'_mem _ _)
          obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hlt
          rw [hd, ← Stream'.drop_drop] at hx
          rw [add_comm]
          exact Hindman.FS_iter_tail_sub_FS _ d hx
        · rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (s.min'_mem hs), ← hxs, Stream'.head_drop]
          rfl
  refine ⟨k, fun i => (a.get i : ℕ), fun i => (a.get i).pos, fun s hs => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := key s hs
  have hc : C x = k := ha (Hindman.FS_iter_tail_sub_FS _ _ hx)
  show C (∑ i ∈ s, (a.get i : ℕ)) = k
  rw [← hxs]; exact hc
target_source: ∀ (κ : Type*) [Finite κ] (C : ℕ → κ), ∃ (c : κ) (a : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < a i) ∧ ∀ s : Finset ℕ, s.Nonempty → C (∑ i ∈ s, a i) = c
